# StikJIT XCFramework

`StikJIT.xcframework` comes from the StikJIT 2.0.1 [GitHub Actions build](https://github.com/StikDebug/StikJIT/actions/runs/41353928680) at commit `b3e01a30ded4cd0b27cf1b6bd42f123bbdf49c3a`.

The Actions artifact SHA-256 is `fc772bd34f6a10508cd750bc0c59ac04eb27a9b9072dd38aca97a554b29e72cc`. The enclosed `StikJIT.xcframework.zip` SHA-256 is `c376687326a785f5ed1da8caca08adc709b56919019dd751bca059b92b175d95`.

Only the iOS slice is included; the tvOS slice is omitted because this project builds for iOS. The outer XCFramework metadata lists only iOS. The iOS framework files, including their bundle metadata, Swift interfaces, and compiled binary, are unchanged from the artifact.
